items.title: Prototype focus
items.summary: Decide whether the first prototype should focus on a live meeting board or a post-meeting summary.

items.title: MVP focus
items.summary: Choose whether the MVP optimizes for implementation speed or for testing the live facilitation experience.
Ask what must be true for the host to monitor the page while also running the meeting.

items.title: Host attention risk
items.summary: The host may not be able to facilitate the meeting and monitor the shared board at the same time.
Ask whether participants will tolerate a shared page during a live conversation.

items.title: Screen-share distraction risk
items.summary: The shared page may distract participants or create visual noise during the meeting.
Test the failure path where agent suggestions arrive too late or feel too generic to change the discussion.

items.title: Agent timing and quality risk
items.summary: Agent suggestions may arrive too late or be too generic to influence the conversation.
Separate the live-board claim from the evidence that people actually want an artifact during the meeting.

items.title: MVP focus: build the live board first
items.summary: The forming MVP decision converged on a human-shared page with timed mock transcript playback before Zoom-native integration.

items.title: Build playback and queue
items.summary: Implement the transcript playback loop and agent queue before Zoom integration.

items.title: Make transcript optional
items.summary: Allow the host to hide or show the transcript rail during screen share.

items.title: Evidence visibility risk
items.summary: Hiding the transcript could make captured items feel less grounded in evidence.

items.title: Open guidance modals
items.summary: Clicking decisions, risks, actions, and agent issues should open facilitation guidance.

items.title: Modal interaction burden
items.summary: Opening modals during a live meeting may add too much interaction burden for the host.

items.title: Allow cleanup of captures
items.summary: Risks and actions can be removed when the host decides they are not useful.

items.title: Dismissal of useful dissent
items.summary: Hosts may remove useful dissent or unresolved risks too quickly.

items.title: Premature agent dismissal
items.summary: Agent issues may be dismissed before the team has considered them.

items.title: Track dismissed items
items.summary: Keep a record of removed items so the meeting record shows what was dismissed and why.

items.title: Use unguessable shared links
items.summary: Prototype dashboards are open-by-link but should not be easy to guess.

items.title: Access control risk
items.summary: Open dashboard links may not be appropriate for sensitive meetings without account-based access controls.

items.title: Retain full transcript
items.summary: Keep the full transcript attached to the meeting record during the prototype.

items.title: Transcript retention risk
items.summary: Full transcript retention may need configurable controls earlier than planned.

items.title: Add retention settings later
items.summary: Add retention settings to production readiness without blocking the static prototype.
